system.description: By mixing owl's blood into a still body of water no larger than a bathtub, the thaumaturge transforms it into a scrying pool, allowing her to observe a known location or, with a personal object of the target, a specific person. The target cannot be changed once cast, and Auspex or other powers cannot be used to affect the scried subject remotely. The vision lasts 10 minutes, extendable by one temporary Mental Trait per additional 10 minutes.
